posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
Nothing from this contest will be published, made, or created by GtG. This is only for fun.

 

This week's event is a contest. Take a look at this picture:

 

![](upload://qtPSA2zxirFoRh076ZPMTLuGFre.jpeg)

 

This will be the picture for a new card in Legacy's deck. Your job is to create that card. You will need to provide the following information:

1) The title

2) The type

3) The full game text

4) The flavor text

GtG will be pick the winner based on how well the card feels and sounds like an SotM card, and how well it fits into Legacy's deck.

In addition to bragging rights, the winner will get to have a 10 minute Google Hangout with the GtG team. This will happen in early December, and the winner will be notified on how to set it up.

Please keep all discussions about this event in this thread, and post all submissions into this thread.

 

Results due by Monday, November 18, 8:00 AM CST.

 

Nothing from this contest will be published, made, or created by GtG. This is only for fun.

posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
This is a great initiative - thanks for setting this up!

If anybody wants to model their card into an image, I have put up the powerpoint document that I used to create mine on my dropbox account:

https://www.dropbox.com/home?select=SOTM%20Legacy%20card.pptx

You will need to have the crashlandingBB and redstatebluestate fonts installed as well as access to Powerpoint. It's a bit of a bodge job but looks cool when you can see it laid out as if it were a real card!
